title: Medic 3 Unit Status Discrepancy

lines.text: Sup, this is Call Taker 4 on Position 4. Medic 3 shows as available on CAD, but the unit’s radio just reported they’re on scene at the Marlow structure fire. The ALI shows 123 S. Main St, Halden, and the GPS tracker shows them 1.2 miles away from the fire. The call has been in queue for 70 seconds.
Copy, CT4. I’m pulling the unit status now. Hold on.
They’re still reporting on scene, Sup. The GPS is not updating. The ALI still shows 123 S. Main. I’ve got a 30-second wait on the queue for this call.
